events.name: Bash
events.head: Check main vs origin, read the build script, list worktrees
events.input: $ git fetch origin -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 7b5f59e origin/main && echo "7b5f59e in origin/main"; git status -sb | head -3; cat -n cloud/scripts/build.sh | head -70; git worktree list | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the two deploy memory notes and check for a publish hold
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory && sed -n 1,40p centre-deploy-clean-worktree.md; echo ----; sed -n 1,30p mirror-export-clean-worktree.md; echo; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create a clean worktree at origin/main and clone node_modules into it
events.input: $ O=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && echo "origin/main ${O:0:8}" && git log --oneline 7b5f59e..origin/main | wc -l && rm -rf /private/tmp/t263-wt 2>/dev/null; git worktree prune; git worktree add --detach /private/tmp/t263-wt "$O" 2>&1 | tail -1 && cp -Rc app/node_modules /private/tmp/t263-wt/app/node_modules && cp -Rc cloud/node_modules /private/tmp/t263-wt/cloud/node_modules && ls /private/tmp/t263-wt/app/node_modules | wc -l && ls -la app/.env.local 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -n "env.local\|\.env" app/scripts/export-static.sh | head -8; cat cloud/wrangler.toml 2>/dev/null | head -12; ls cloud

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the centre build in the clean worktree with tracing
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t263-wt && (bash -x cloud/scripts/build.sh > /tmp/t263-build.log 2>&1; echo "exit $?"); wc -l /tmp/t263-build.log; grep -v '^+' /tmp/t263-build.log | tail -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: Typecheck the worktree, show the latest deployments and pending remote migrations
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t263-wt/cloud && grep -n '"name"\|database_name\|"main"' wrangler.jsonc | head; ls public/onboarding | head -5; grep -c "tantraSenderStatus" src/*.ts | grep -v ":0"; (npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "tsc exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"); npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | tail -12; npx wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote 2>&1 | tail -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare local main to origin for centre-affecting changes, confirm typecheck exit code
events.input: $ date -u +%FT%TZ; git log --format='%h %cI %s' origin/main..main | cut -c1-110; echo; git diff --stat origin/main main -- cloud app | tail -8; git log -1 --format='%h %cI' origin/main; cd /private/tmp/t263-wt/cloud && npx tsc --noEmit -p . ; echo "tsc exit $?"

events.text: Build works in the clean worktree (2082 files, tsc clean) with a real copy of node_modules. Now doing a dry-run and then the approved deploy of revops-centre from origin/main 6c40e376.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Dry-run, then deploy the revops-centre Worker from the clean worktree
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/t263-wt/cloud && git -C /private/tmp/t263-wt status --porcelain | head -5; npx wrangler deploy --dry-run 2>&1 | tail -6 && npx wrangler deploy 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | tail -14

events.name: Bash
events.head: List Tantra key variable names (no values), find the API call shape and FintechCircle sender notes
events.input: $ ls -a | grep -i "^\.env" ; for f in .env app/.env.local cloud/.dev.vars; do [ -f $f ] && echo "== $f" && grep -o '^[A-Za-z_]*\(TANTRA\|FINTECH\)[A-Za-z_]*' $f; done; grep -n "async function tn\|TANTRA_BASE\|tantra_key\|x-api-key\|Authorization" cloud/src/jobs-tantra.ts cloud/src/agentic.ts | head -12; grep -n "tantraSenderStatus" -A14 cloud/src/agentic.ts | head -45; grep -rn "fintechcircle" -i --include=*.md /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/ | cut -c1-260 | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate env files and Tantra key variable names only, read the sender status function
events.input: $ find . -maxdepth 3 -name ".env*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head; find . -maxdepth 3 \( -name ".env*" -o -name ".dev.vars" \) -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -exec sh -c 'echo "== $1"; grep -o "^[A-Za-z0-9_]*" "$1" | grep -i "tantra\|fintech\|circle" ' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -n "export async function tantraSenderStatus" -B3 -A14 cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts | head -40; grep -rIl -i "fintechcircle" /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory/ | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: List env variable names only, read the Tantra request helper, search memory for where the Tantra key lives
events.input: $ for f in app/.env.local cloud/.dev.vars; do echo "== $f"; grep -o '^[A-Za-z0-9_]*' $f | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done; grep -n "^async function tn" -A10 cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts | head -16; M=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory; grep -rIn -i "tantra.\{0,30\}\(api key\|key\).\{0,80\}\(\.env\|keychain\|stored\|lives\)" $M | cut -c1-300 | head -8; grep -n -i "fintechcircle" $M/MEMORY.md | cut -c1-250 | head -5; ls ~/tantra-redesign/../ 2>/dev/null | grep -i "env\|secret" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the key-location memory note, list key store file names, read Tantra URL and header helpers
events.input: $ M=/Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory; sed -n 1,25p $M/gather-context-from-all-sessions.md | cut -c1-900; echo ---; ls -la ~/.config/tantra/ ~/.config/tantra/keys 2>&1 | awk '{print $1, $5, $9}' | head -40; grep -n "function tantraUrl" -A6 -n /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/src/connectors/*.ts /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/src/*.ts | head -20; grep -n "function tantraHeaders" -A3 -r /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/src | head -6

events.name: Bash
events.head: List key store entry names and types without values, find Tantra URL and header helpers

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show test env variable names with values hidden, and the Tantra URL helper location
events.input: $ cd ~/.config/tantra && sed -E 's/^([A-Za-z0-9_]+)=.*/\1=<hidden>/' keys/vendor-test.env | cut -c1-160; sed -n 44,50p ROTATION_PLAN.md | cut -c1-220; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -rn "tantraUrl\|tantraHeaders" cloud/src/connectors/*.ts | grep -v "tn<\|await" | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the rotation plan header on Tantra keys and how the connector check script reads the Tantra key
events.input: $ cd ~/.config/tantra && sed -n 1,20p ROTATION_PLAN.md | cut -c1-260; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign && grep -n "vendor-test\|TANTRA" cloud/scripts/connector-checks.mjs | head -8; grep -n "TN = \|const TN\|function TN" -A3 cloud/src/connectors/stack.ts | head -8
